### Bible Pathways - July 28, 2006
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-july-28-2006-1409932.html
Passage: Ecclesiastes 2:4-10
Points:
- Solomon pursued immense building projects, earthly riches, and personal pleasures entirely for himself.
- Self-centered indulgence yielded diminishing satisfaction, ending in futility and deep frustration.
- Worldly achievements and wealth fail to offer true or lasting fulfillment apart from God.
- Genuine peace and meaning come only from pursuing God's kingdom and living for His eternal purpose.

### Doing vs. Being
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/day-by-day-feb-3-2010-11625734.html
Passage: Ecclesiastes 2:11-26
Points:
- Society frequently measures success by external achievements, career status, and tangible rewards.
- Focusing entirely on what we accomplish can leave a person spiritually hollow and empty inside.
- God places far greater emphasis on who we become than on what we do.
- Developing inner character and godly virtues requires a lifetime but creates lasting treasure.
